headline_marked: [[Morocco beat Scotland 1-0]] with record-fast 71-second goal in World Cup Group C
headline: Morocco beat Scotland 1-0 with record-fast 71-second goal in World Cup Group C
summary: Ismael Saibari's early strike propelled the North African team to victory, significantly boosting their chances of advancing to the World Cup's round of 32.
details: Morocco secured a 1-0 victory over Scotland in Group C of the World Cup on Friday. Ismael Saibari scored his second goal in as many games after just 71 seconds, positioning the North Africans strongly to advance into the round of 32.

The goal came barely a minute into the match when Saibari received a pass from Brahim Diaz. He expertly lashed the ball past goalkeeper Angus Gunn, leaving Scotland's defenders watching. Morocco displayed superior class throughout much of the first half.

Despite Steve Clarke's men showing more intensity after the break, Morocco nearly doubled their lead. An effort by Saibari was deflected onto the bar shortly after the interval, maintaining the narrow lead.

Morocco now has four points, having drawn 1-1 with Brazil in their opening match, and will face Haiti in their final group game. Scotland, with three points after beating Haiti 1-0, still has a chance to reach the knockout round for the first time, concluding their group stage against Brazil next Wednesday.
